roc._note: class_map is keyed on the FULL license class code, taken from the Class Detail column of a real ROC export. Suffix-based inference is unsound: A-11 is Steel Erection while CR-11 is Electrical, and A-14 is Asphalt Paving while CR-14 is Fencing. Inference order: (1) exact class_map hit, (2) description keywords, (3) business-name keywords, (4) 'general' at low confidence.
roc.source: ROC New Licenses List, 2024-05-22, 3876 records, 129 distinct class codes
